fieldValues.title: workflow_dispatch is exempt from the GITHUB_TOKEN no-CI restriction; a PAT is never needed just to get checks running
fieldValues.summary: GitHub never fires pull_request or push workflows for an event (a PR open, a branch push) created with the default GITHUB_TOKEN — required status checks silently never run. This is often read as a reason to reach for a PAT (owner already rejected that for cross-repo notification on srs-rust#914). It is not: workflow_dispatch and repository_dispatch ARE dispatchable by the ambient GITHUB_TOKEN, same-repo, no new credential. The fix for any workflow that opens PRs or pushes branches with the Actions token is: declare workflow_dispatch on the workflow(s) carrying the required checks (a no-op addition, safe on any workflow), then call `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` right after the push.
fieldValues.rationale: First found and fixed in srs-rust#979 (schema-sync.yml's scheduled PRs sat with zero checks, e.g. #978 before it was reopened by hand). The same shape will recur wherever a scheduled or bot workflow opens a PR against a repo with required status checks — srs-vscode's own schema-sync automation (still manual per srs-rust CLAUDE.md's Schema Sync section) is a named future instance. Re-open this only if GitHub changes which triggers respect GITHUB_TOKEN, or if a workflow needs dispatch on a REMOTE repository (that case still needs the poll-not-dispatch answer in carried-context-be762b7a, not this one).
